question: What remains beyond a strong co-expression estimator when the RNA target is held fixed?
stage: Both CRC sources are previously exposed; this new method comparison is exploratory.
primary_target: H_vd = equal-type average of equal-cell E[P_ITGAV P_ITGB6]
secondary_target: R2=1-max(edge H)/sum(edge H); full4 in D and simulations, common3 in D/I

official_comparator.same_target_conversion: raw mu[g]*mu[h]+raw covar[g,h], not processed correlation
official_comparator.parameter_capture: Python return-event tracing; official file is unchanged
official_comparator.numpy_compatibility: module-local facade supplies np.Inf=np.inf; no arithmetic changes
official_comparator.version_scope: Official Python publication implementation; current R 1.1.0 docs also inspected, not claimed to have been run
official_comparator.zero_count_selection: Exclude genes with zero total observed count within the fitted sample; complete their measured H edges at zero. Missing source genes remain unavailable.
official_comparator.negative_H: Retain raw estimates; separately project to H>=0 for constrained graph use.
official_comparator.failure_handling: Report native failures and all-pair coverage. Practical comparator uses equal-cell moments for nonfinite/failed edge estimates, with projection of finite estimates to H>=0. Never remove failed patients from the denominator.
official_comparator.convergence: Record j and actual final delta; preserve the official returned estimates even if delta exceeds tolerance.

same_input_budget: Same patients, cell-type subsets, selected raw UMI counts and full-RNA depth; no additional biological observations.
poisson_estimator: mean Xg Xh/S^2 with a common supplied, known exposure S; do not use S(S-1) for Poisson counts

original_simulation.replay: Exactly replay the original raw-count RNG sequence; verify source snapshots for every case and cached equal-cell H scores.
original_simulation.strata: 4 families x 2 signal types x 3 depth designs x 32 cohorts
original_simulation.state_dependent_depth: Model stress test: equal-cell joint target remains fixed; homogeneous moment regressions need not target that equal-cell population.

additional_poisson_control.measurement: Independent gene-wise Poisson(S*P) conditional on latent state. The same known S is supplied to both estimators.
additional_poisson_control.independent_variable: Per-cell iid log-uniform exposure 1000..16000, independent of latent state.
additional_poisson_control.state_dependent: S=[8000,16000,2000,2000,2000] indexed by the latent state; explicit misspecification test.
additional_poisson_control.latent_population: Exactly the original five-state constructor; truth uses its known equal-cell weights.
additional_poisson_control.null: Truth-identical patients; directional accuracy is undefined, so report bias/RMSE and estimated resolution.

real_data.interpretation: Real data have no latent H truth; technical direction retention is repeatability, not accuracy.
real_data.missing_ITGB3: I uses common3; missing gene is never an observed zero.

metrics.simulation_primary: Strict correct directions among all known true-distinct patient pairs; ties or failed fits unsuccessful.
metrics.also: H bias, RMSE, mean absolute error; R2 error/directions; fit status and negative estimates.
metrics.paired_intervals: Resample independent simulation cohorts within each case; equal case weights; 5000 draws, seed 2610109292.
metrics.real_intervals: Descriptive paired patient bootstrap, common patient resamples across methods; technical repetitions do not increase patient N.
metrics.success_rule: No universal superiority threshold; report favorable, equal and unfavorable same-target results by measurement/depth stratum.

Rk_comparator.exact_rarefaction: Classical complete subset U-statistic is identical to our conditional hypergeometric estimator; verify by direct subset enumeration.
Rk_comparator.Monte_Carlo: Prior one/eight subset randomized baselines already share R8; reuse those results with source hashes.
Rk_comparator.strong_addition: Exact fixed-k multinomial plug-in using each observed X/L, without Monte Carlo. Compare at k=8 on the same counts and cohorts.
Rk_comparator.claim_scope: Graph resolution target and identities are the candidate contribution. Rao-Blackwellization and U-statistics themselves are established techniques.
